programmes.t: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "De Hoop Marine Protected Area"
programmes.d: In this episode Tali explores the various creatures that reside in De Hoop Marine Protected Area, from the Greater White Pelicans and Chacma baboons to the large Eland.

programmes.t: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Agulhas"
programmes.d: Cape Agulhas is the true meeting place of the Atlantic and Indian Oceans, a place of immense cultural and natural value. Tali searches for answers to her burning questions about establishing new parks and the roles communities play in this process.

programmes.t: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cedarberg Biodiversity"
programmes.d: Using a novel conservation model, the Greater Cedarberg Biodiversity Initiative is ensuring that the land is used in an efficient way, with the land and its inhabitants work in harmony. Tali investigate the various ways being used to achieve this.

programmes.t: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Floristic Region"
programmes.d: Tali investigates the struggle to protect the Cape Floristic Region, one of the world’s 6 floral kingdoms and the only one entirely within the borders of a single country. She finds out more about why this region is in critical need of conservation.

programmes.t: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Working For Water"
programmes.d: In this episode we turn our attention to the damaging effects of invasive alien plants on our country’s water supply. Tali looks at three initiatives, Working for Wetlands; Working for Water and the Water Neutral Scheme.

programmes.t: City Zoo S1 - "Big Cats"
programmes.d: In this episode we meet the Big Cats. The zoo crew treats a tiger called Lolo with a toothache. Adrian and Jacquie rescue three teenage lion cubs from an illegal facility and transport them to their new home at City Zoo.

programmes.t: City Zoo S1 - "Rhino’s"
programmes.d: In this episode we learn to tell the difference between both the white and black rhino residents. Adrian and the zoo crew travel to the Lichtenburg Breeding centre to monitor a herd of white rhino.

programmes.t: City Zoo S1 - "The Birds"
programmes.d: In this episode Cape Vultures are given a new lease on life. The zoo crew monitors the success of their Cape Vulture breeding program, so that this rare species endures.

programmes.t: City Zoo S1 - "Primates"
programmes.d: In this episode Adrian, the zoo vet, treats Lesser White monkey with a weight issue. The zoo's three chimpanzees have their annual health check and Adrian becomes concerned that the eldest female is showing signs of ill health.

programmes.t: Green China Rising
programmes.d: From the world’s biggest polluter to a powerhouse of green innovation, China’s fight for survival begins now.

programmes.t: How Things Work S1 - "Chainsaws, Jukeboxes, and Fishing Reels"
programmes.d: Chainsaw, jukebox, fishing reel, car wash, blender and bicycle pump... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programmes.t: How Things Work S1 - "Escalators, Leaf Blowers, and Music Boxes"
programmes.d: Escalator, leaf blower, tape measure, security safe, tennis ball launcher, music box... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programmes.t: How Things Work S1 - "Lawnmowers, Pinball Machines and Padlocks"
programmes.d: Lawn mower, pinball machine, padlock, watch, toilet, yo-yo... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.

programmes.t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Mega Towing"
programmes.d: Specialized XXL tow units execute high-risk rescue missions, retrieving heavy military vehicles and towing the world's largest aircraft.

programmes.t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Antonov An-225"
programmes.d: Equipped with six engines, the Antonov An-225 transports massive electrical transformers across the high Andes mountains.

programmes.t: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Bridging the Gap"
programmes.d: Nathan battles strong winds on a big roofing job, Dave handles an easy lift, J.P. moves a hot tub, and Dan faces confusion on a bridge build.

programmes.t: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Special Delivery"
programmes.d: Regional Crane’s new machine hits a hydraulic snag. Dave uses his downtime for repairs, and Brad helps clear a stand of pine trees.

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Axes/Messenger Bags/Fast Rescue Boats"
programmes.d: How do they forge one of the greatest inventions of all time, the axe? How do they cut, sew, stitch and glue together a courier’s messenger bag? How do they build the world’s fastest lifeboats?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Wensleydale Cheese/Paintbrushes/Eucalyptus Oil/Plastic Wrap"
programmes.d: How do they do Wallace and Gromit’s cheese of choice, Wensleydale? How do they turn pig hair into paintbrushes? How do they distill aromatic oils from the koala’s favourite food, eucalyptus? How do they make the plastic that keeps your food fresh?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Tesla/Horse Hair Fabrics/Pool Cleaners"
programmes.d: How do they build the world’s fastest electric car? How do they turn horses’ tails into fine fabrics? How do they clean the world’s largest swimming pools?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Snails/Cutlery/Fishing Kayaks"
programmes.d: How do they feed France’s appetite for snails? How do they turn slabs of steel into shiny cutlery? How do they craft a kayak you can paddle with your feet?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Emergency Bridges/Marker Pens/Electric superbike"
programmes.d: How do they build emergency bridges that can take the weight of a tank? How do they make a marker pen that never fades? How do they design a 200 mph superbike?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Crystal Glass/Flat Screen TVs/Deepest Pool/Ketchup"
programmes.d: How do they blow the world’s finest crystal wine glasses? How do they make the world’s slimmest TVs? How do they heat the world’s deepest swimming pool? How do they fill a million bottles a day of the world’s favourite ketchup?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Pulverizer/Bomber Jackets/Lambic Beer/"
programmes.d: How do they forge a set of jaws that can chomp through concrete and demolish tower blocks? How do they stitch the historic airman’s bomber? How do they brew the oldest beer in the Western World?

programmes.t: How Do They Do It S13 - "Sydney Opera House/Handsaws/Microphones/Icebreaker"
programmes.d: How do they cool Sydney’s famous Opera House? How do they turn Sheffield steel into a carpenter’s handsaw? How do they make a microphone that can pick up a whisper? How do they steer a safe course through a frozen river?

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "A Year of Space Odyssey"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli explores the amazing journeys of spacecraft that gathered spectacular images of Mercury, Jupiter and Mars.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Surviving in Deep Space"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at how surviving in deep space can become a reality.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Spectacular Space Views"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at the incredible phenomena of our universe, and our own planet’s turbulent atmosphere.

programmes.t: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Legends of Apollo"
programmes.d: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at the accomplishments of Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin, the two astronauts who first landed on the moon.

programmes.t: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Invention War"
programmes.d: Can you improve on the inventions of Da Vinci? Matt and Jeremy aim to find out as they take four re-invented weapons from past episodes and rethink, redesign, and rebuild them using modern technology.

programmes.t: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Snow Annihilator"
programmes.d: Bizarre way to remove snow from roads. Will it work or will it just be a mobile furnace?

programmes.t: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Bulletproof Protection"
programmes.d: See how inventions from the First World War work.

programmes.t: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Fire Fighting"
programmes.d: It's literally a baptism by fire for two old flame-fighting patents. Will they pass the test or go up in smoke?

programmes.t: DRONERS S1 - "Guerilla Droners"
programmes.d: From New York to Hong Kong, DRONERS tags along with FPV crews to cover underground races and meet the key-players in the emerging drone community.

programmes.t: DRONERS S1 - "Kid Droners"
programmes.d: DRONERS goes behind-the-scenes at an international racing tournament to discover the young pilots climbing the ranks - and raking in the cash along the way.

programmes.t: DRONERS S1 - "Freestyle Droners"
programmes.d: DRONERS races cars, flies up mountains, and explores abandoned buildings in a rush of adventure to find out what it really takes to be a freestyle pilot.

programmes.d: DRONERS discovers how the technological advances driven by the FPV community are pushing the envelope of what’s possible in this fast-moving community
